[EN] Balder's Balm
[ES] Bálsamo de Balder
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Ruma what he needs and bring the herbs to me.
[ES] Pregúntale a Ruma qué necesita y tráeme las hierbas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] If you're ever sick, swing by.
[ES] Si alguna vez te enfermas, pásate por aquí.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find {@LinkCreature:71#3003#Ruma}.
[ES] Encuentra a {@LinkCreature:71#3003#Ruma}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Leave it to me."
[ES] "Déjamelo a mí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You're welcome!"
[ES] "¡De nada!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather moon shadow plants around {@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}.
[ES] Recolecta plantas de sombra lunar alrededor de {@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the moon shadow plants to {@LinkCreature:71#3005#Buran}.
[ES] Entrégale las plantas de sombra lunar a {@LinkCreature:71#3005#Buran}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather moonlight lotuses around {@Rgn:30014$$Seren's Lake}.
[ES] Recolecta lotos de luz de luna alrededor de {@Rgn:30014$$Seren's Lake}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the moonlight lotuses to {@LinkCreature:71#3005#Buran}.
[ES] Entrégale los lotos de luz de luna a {@LinkCreature:71#3005#Buran}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
